svg.title: Risk-coverage, matched_strings, native prompts (held-out test half)
svg.desc: Error rate among the most confident test questions as coverage grows; exact confidence ties are averaged. Right: AURC, lower is better. T = held-out temperature; with two choices it keeps the ranking up to floating-point ties.

g.text: Risk-coverage, matched_strings, native prompts (held-out test half)
Error rate among the most confident test questions as coverage grows; exact confidence ties are averaged.
Right: AURC, lower is better. T = held-out temperature; with two choices it keeps the ranking up to floating-point ties.
